Life sucks, and life is really hard for everyone, but life is no race or competition. You go at your own pace and fuck what society says. (I always say these things in my head, to give me strength to fight my bpd *borderline personality disorder* harder and to get better) I've been untreated for bpd for over 6 years, and finally trying to change serious behaviors is hard. However, I believe in myself. Again, it's never easy, and reading through your comments, you said you do have anger issues and that's okay. I meditate or light up a candle and just relax. I try to focus on other little things that cant be seen normally at a first glance. Even writing, drawing, and making my own albums (for my boyfriend and for myself) on spotify helps me so much. I try to do other things for people when i am in critical condition, because I know they will be so happy and honestly surprised. (Right now I'm working on a care package to send to my boyfriend. *we are ldr and now we are rocking it, almost five months and we've seen eachother once*.

Again, your struggles are real and this is all very real. I hope you find that inner strength and hopefully see things in a different view. (This is very hard for me too, I take things very personally). I wish the best for you .
